meta.name: Remaking the Middle East
meta.description: Remaking the Middle Easttraces the road to the current war with Iran, Israel and the United States, as well as outlining some of the stakes for the region. The film draws on historical archive to document how Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long-campaigned for a bombing of Iran and the obliteration of Palestine, as well as his relations with the United States over Iran’s purported nuclear program.
